case_number: 2025 INSC 330; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1184 OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (Crl.) NO. 6320 OF 2024)
summary: Section 319 CrPC summoning procedure; evidence standard: sufficient/cogent, not conclusive; High Court erred by intervening in pending trial after conclusion of trial; no inquiry into proposed accused identities despite FIR inclusion; no final report exonerating proposed accused; PW testimony insufficient for summoning; post-trial revision improper; legislative history and scope of 'could be tried together' analyzed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court revision set aside; Trial Court's dismissal of summoning application under Section 319 CrPC restored.
